title: As 30% of Japan's temples risk disappearance by 2040, monks are using AI to help people speak with Buddha
summary_full: By 2040, Japanese temples may face closure due to dwindling religious commitment among the populace. In a bid to attract more visitors spiritually, monks are embracing artificial intelligence to improve operational efficiency and enhance communication with worshippers. While some view AI as a useful guide in matters of faith, others argue that the essential human connection is irreplaceable.
